answer: Thanksgiving Eve NYC 2026 is Wednesday, November 25, the night before Thanksgiving on Thursday the 26th. Our list has 22 parties that night, most of them in Bushwick (Elsewhere, SILO Brooklyn, The Chocolate Factory, LISTEN), Williamsburg (Superior Ingredients, Signal, The Meadows, Sleepwalk), the Lower East Side (The DL, The Delancey, VIRGO, ArtSpace) and Chelsea (Marquee New York, Somewhere Nowhere NYC, Music For A While). Start at a bar with a Wednesday happy hour near your party: Vacations or SURA in Bushwick, Post No Bills or Kent Ale House in Williamsburg, or Porchlight in Chelsea.

Thanksgiving weekend NYC nights run from Wednesday, November 25 to Sunday, November 29, 2026, with 85 published parties on our calendar: 22 on Wednesday, 1 on Thursday, 24 on Friday, 34 on Saturday and 4 on Sunday. Wednesday has Louie Vega's Flashback at Superior Ingredients, and Thursday has Ground Control's Thanksgiving night with KOFLA and Cristian Arango. Friday brings Guy Gerber at Pacha New York, Saturday has Felix Da Housecat at House of Yes and Mathame at Pacha, and Sunday opens with Chus & Ceballos at Superior Ingredients.
